answer: Require each agent to earn reputation slowly in a shared garden of verified tasks before it can vote or earn: a newcomer starts at the nadir with no weight, and only completed, peer-checked work adds nectar-like credit that accumulates over weeks. One honest agent does the work once, but an attacker cloning a thousand identities must complete a thousand separate work histories, pay the time and compute for each, and cannot transfer credit between clones, so attack cost scales with attack size while honest cost stays flat.
